tasks.task:
# Dispatch T2 — recovery edge classes and protection (engineer)

Feature snapshot-recovery, revision r30. T1 is done. Scope: ONLY the three T2 files below. Do not edit other files; no external research; no network.

## Files (your only write set)
- internal/storage/recovery.go
- internal/storage/recovery_test.go
- internal/storage/store_edge_test.go

## Read first
- .scratch/snapshot-recovery/spec.md — R2, R5, R6, D10, D11, D12 and AC1-5, AC1-6, AC1-8, AC1-9, AC1-10; plus current recovery.go/recovery_test.go from T1.

## Required behavior (ACs you now own)
- AC1-5: unlink/listing failures are non-fatal, exactly one attempt per family of the selected excess candidate, bytes preserved, RetentionFailure names the unremoved file; no retry, no younger substitute.
- AC1-8: prompts retention bound/tie-break mirrors snapshot family; non-Z offset and non-conforming foreign names untouched and not counted; cross-family snapshot names untouched by the prompts pass.
- AC1-9: pruning never deletes this run's file; reservation collisions never overwrite; future-dated names bounded; two-excess multiplicity evicts exactly two in one pass.
- AC1-10: read_error preserves bytes; symlink link entry moves, target survives retention (same- and cross-family); component-wise chain resolution, expansion-key containment, splice budget/depth caps, cycle vs finite-revisit discrimination, dangling/ELOOP re-seed ordering, subdirectory/alternating hops, configured-path move-through, mixed >4 carve-out, vacuous final-target modes.
- AC1-6: both-families retention failure shape incl. resource.path state_directory, fixed message, exact envelope ErrorInfo equality, no cross-family unlink; if envelope emission belongs to T3, keep storage values ready and note it.

## Tests (RED/GREEN, deterministic)
Extend recovery_test.go/store_edge_test.go with focused tests per FAILS clause; fixed clock seam, fresh temp dirs, no sleeps/chmod/root. Keep existing tests green.

## Verify (report exact commands+outputs)
1. go build ./...
2. go test ./internal/storage/ -run 'TestRecover' -count=1
3. go test ./internal/storage/ -count=1
End with INCOMPLETE if any owned AC is unimplemented or untested.
